title.narrative: Support for Small Island Developing States (SIDS) DOCK Support Program Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"The Program aims to support the Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to transition to low carbon economies through development and deployment of renewable energy (RE) resources and promotion of greater energy efficiency (EE). These objectives closely reflect the Bank's energy strategy in recent years, specifically the Bank Group's commitment at Bonn in 2004 to scale up energy efficiency and new renewable energy relating to addressing climate change. Further, the objectives are closely aligned with the Bank's Post Crisis Strategic Development Priorities relating to helping client governments ""create opportunities for growth"" and ""manage risks and prepare for crises"".
The support to the SIDS was formally endorsed at Cancun in Dec 2010 through an MOU between the WBG, Government of Denmark, UNDP, and AOSIS (representing the SIDS governments and hence their endorsement). The MOU is attached in Section 5.4.
ESMAP has closely consulted with the Bank regions in developing the proposal, and the Regions submitted several well-developed project activities for funding support. The projects, attached in Section 5.4., demonstrate that the country offices welcome the proposed new set of activities and specific targetted approach conceived under the SIDS Program."
